claims.subject: income_threshold
claims.statement: A household must have a combined annual income below $90,000 to be eligible.
claims.quote: To be eligible, a household must have a combined annual income below $90,000.

claims.subject: grant_amounts
claims.statement: Every eligible household receives a flat $5,000.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The property must be the household's main residence and be in the flood-affected area.
claims.quote: The property must be the household's main residence and must be in the flood-affected area.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: Payment is made once the application has been approved.
claims.quote: The payment is made once the application has been approved.
